title: Freedom Yield Metal — Anchor Source v1
description: Canonical source for A-chain anchor content. The runtime file /api/anchor-source.json is generated by scripts/gen-anchor-source.sh from live sources (validator.json, uptime-history.jsonl, P-chain RPC, git). Its dag_root_computed field is the 32-byte value broadcast to Metal A-chain via HC-single 4-action pack (memo prefix fyid1v1c<cycle>-<branch>). Verb discipline: only observation / notarization verbs (_observed, _asserts, _computed, _at, _from). Obligation verbs (_target, _promised, _committed, _sla, _cadence) are forbidden. Companion docs: docs/ANCHOR_SOURCE.md.

$schema.description: Self-reference to this schema's URL. Recommended for tooling.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. v1 stays at 1; bump requires new schema URL.

computed_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this anchor-source.json was generated. Observation verb (past tense).

computed_by_script.description: Name and semver of the generator script that produced this file. Example: 'gen-anchor-source.sh v1.0'.

computed_from_git_commit.description: 40-char git commit hash of the metal.freedom-yield.com repo at generation time. Enables verifiers to replay the source that produced this anchor.

identity_branch.description: Who we are, in cryptographic + on-chain terms. Anonymous pseudonymous claim; no legal identity binding.

operator_ed25519_pubkey_sha256_hex.description: SHA-256 of the operator's ed25519 public key (raw 32 bytes), hex-encoded 64 chars. Universal binary format (no SSH-style prefix).

operator_asserts_node_id.description: NodeID that we (the operator) assert we operate. Verb: 'asserts' = anonymous pseudonymous claim, not third-party-verifiable but signed under our identity key.

prev_anchor_root.description: dag_root_computed of the immediately preceding anchor. Null for the first (genesis) anchor. Establishes hash chain — subsequent anchors reference this to prevent silent gap insertion.

prev_anchor_tx.description: XPR-side tx ID of the previous anchor broadcast. Null for genesis anchor. Redundant with prev_anchor_root but improves audit ergonomics.

key_seq.description: Operator identity key generation counter. Increments only on key rotation. Persists across cycles.

identity_history_root.description: SHA-256 Merkle root of identity-history.jsonl (= complete key rotation history). Enables verifiers to detect silent key rotation.

observations_branch.description: What we observed during the anchored cycle. Observation verbs only (_observed, _at). Includes full delegator lifecycle events for institutional audit trail.

cycle_number_observed.description: Freedom Yield internal cycle counter (no P-chain concept). Increments each time our validator re-registers.

cycle_start_time_observed.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of the cycle's startTime as we observed it via platform.getCurrentValidators.

cycle_end_time_observed.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of the cycle's endTime. Null while the cycle is open at anchor time.

self_stake_observed_metal.description: Self-stake amount in human-readable METAL units, as we observed it.

self_stake_observed_nmetal.description: Self-stake amount in P-chain canonical nMETAL (nAVAX) units, as string to avoid JS number precision loss.

fee_percent_observed_at_cycle_start.description: Delegation fee percent as observed at cycle start (immutable during cycle per P-chain protocol). Not a promise — fee may differ in next cycle at operator's discretion.

delegator_lifecycle_events_in_cycle_obse.description: All delegator lifecycle events (started / ended) observed during this cycle. Complete audit trail; hidden delegator events are impossible under this schema.

event_type.description: Lifecycle event type. 'started' = we observed the delegation appear in current validators. 'ended' = we observed the delegation disappear (duration expiry or early withdrawal).

observed_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when we observed the event via our cron-driven RPC polling.

weight_nmetal.description: Delegation weight in nMETAL, as string.

observed_end_time.description: For 'started' events: the endTime we observed at delegation start. Absent for 'ended' events.

actual_end_cause_observed.description: For 'ended' events: cause classification based on our observation heuristics (comparing observed_at with observed_end_time). Absent for 'started' events.

delegator_snapshot_at_cycle_end.description: Snapshot of remaining delegators at cycle end (or at anchor time if cycle is open). Complementary to delegator_lifecycle_events (which shows event history).

artifacts_branch.description: Hashes and observations over our public API artifacts + operational observations for the anchored period. Enables tamper-evident post-hoc audit.

public_api_manifest_root.description: SHA-256 binary Merkle root of public_api_files_hashed[].sha256. Leaf order = path lexicographic sort. Internal nodes = sha256(left_hex || right_hex). Odd-count leaves: last leaf duplicated (Bitcoin convention).

public_api_files_hashed.description: SHA-256 of each anchored public API file, path lexicographically sorted.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the file's raw bytes.

period_uptime_observed_pct.description: Uptime percent observed during the anchored period (from prev anchor to now). Observation, not commitment.

period_incident_count_observed.description: Count of Priority: high or Priority: urgent notifications fired during the anchored period. Observation, not SLA.

dag_root_computed.description: SHA-256 of (identity_root_hex || observations_root_hex || artifacts_root_hex), where each branch root = SHA-256 of the branch's RFC 8785 JSON canonical form. Verifiers can recompute this independently from the anchor-source.json without trusting our tools.
